description: This PHP source file defines the TemplateRadioEnum class, which extends TemplateEnum. It provides methods for generating HTML form elements, particularly radio button options, for use in the SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM platform. The class manages rendering radio input elements, getting field definitions, search interfaces, and detail views with support for localization and dynamic content.

classes.name: TemplateRadioEnum
classes.description: Represents a radio selection enum field in SuiteCRM, providing methods for rendering HTML form elements and managing field definitions for the system.

methods.name: get_html_edit
methods.description: Returns the HTML snippet for editing this field as radio options.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Returns the field definition array including database type and separator.

methods.name: get_xtpl_edit
methods.description: Prepares template variables for editing this field, including radio options.

methods.name: generateRadioButtons
methods.description: Generates HTML code for radio button options based on the provided values.

methods.name: get_xtpl_search
methods.description: Prepares template variables for search interfaces with radio options.

methods.name: get_xtpl_detail
methods.description: Returns display value for the detail view based on current bean data.

methods.name: get_db_default
methods.description: Provides default database value, empty in this definition.
